svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 举一反三 (traditional 舉一反三), jǔ yī fǎn sān, “Shown one corner, find the other three”. Fix the bug, then go looking for the rest of its class. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.
